item.title: Identify Reno arch typeface
item.description:
Hello,
I’m a graphic designer in Reno and have been searching for the font used in the iconic Reno arch (link to picture here http://www.zazzle.com/reno_sign_white_photo-190514313624163826). For the life of me, I can’t find a font that matches.

Anyone know this typeface?
